en: Black‑and‑white view of a rustic, chalet‑style wooden building complex surrounded by lush climbing plants and bushes. The architecture features log‑frame columns, decorative diagonal timber cladding, steep shingled roofs with small towers or spires, and verandas. In the foreground are garden tables and chairs on a gravel terrace, giving the impression of a café or garden restaurant. The photograph is framed like an old postcard, but only a small hanging sign with unreadable writing is visible.
